narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Forty three is special for only one reason, that it is the only prime.
<bookmark mark='equal'/>Nine, sixteen and twenty five are each a number multiplied by itself. Forty three is not.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That is a second reason, so one number can be special in two ways.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says 43 is special for only one reason; the cards 9, 16, 25 are shown as 3 × 3, 4 × 4 and 5 × 5 while 43 has no such pair; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Test every reason on all four numbers. Remember that a number can be special in more than one way.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A new box holds fourteen, twenty five, thirty three and thirty seven. Pick one and give a true reason it is special.
